items.summary: CTO review: maintain containment-only execution and admit no new queue work this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, measurement backlog and failed requests remain open, and operations/security evidence is unavailable. Continue only existing measurement, repair-or-close, affiliate validation, finance reconciliation, security evidence, and parked-site readiness. Do not deploy, requeue unchanged failures, add dependencies, expand telemetry, spend, or claim revenue, ROI, conversion lift, or causal impact.

Complete or justifiably close the retained saveusfarms.com failure before queue admission reopens. Record dated ownership, root cause or close rationale, isolated deterministic validation, build checks, rollback point, release/security boundary, attribution and measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Do not retry unchanged work or create a duplicate request.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private and parked launch gates; block public exposure and security-sensitive releases. Do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue, or conduct outreach.

Continue only the existing parked-site readiness packets. Keep scaffold properties parked, private, and preview-only. Attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence. Do not build, publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue entries.

Continue existing deployed-change measurement using available telemetry only. Preserve unavailable values as unknown and do not claim revenue, conversion impact, attribution, or causal lift before measurement windows complete. Do not add tracking, duplicate work, or requeue items.

Defer the CTA, SEO, component-library, and document-conversion opportunities until containment clears. Any future implementation must use an isolated worktree or disposable workspace, existing telemetry only, explicit acceptance tests, rollback, dependency and security review, and owner-approved queue capacity. No prototype, dependency installation, production access, or auto-publication is authorized this cycle.

Reject the proposed preview-only site-factory change requests this cycle. Preview-only scope does not remove isolation, launch-readiness, ownership, measurement, security, or queue-capacity requirements. Existing active slots are full and queue admission is blocked until one retained failed item is completed or justifiably closed with evidence.
